title: ECG Simulator
summary: Cardiac electrophysiology laboratory — interactive 3D heart, activation→vector→12-lead ECG pipeline, continuous recording monitor, and physiology-driven pathology scenarios.
problem: How can we connect tissue-level conduction models to interpretable clinical ECG waveforms — including disease states — without hardcoding lead millivolts?
architecture: Cardiac anatomy → electrophysiology → electrical activation → electrical vector → body-surface potential → 12-lead ECG → clinical interpretation. Disease packs alter the physiological model once; glow, monitor, and leads update together.
designPhilosophy: Prefer mechanistic clarity over black-box accuracy; diseases never hardcode waveforms — they alter physiology once, and glow + ECG update together.
implementation: Embedded build from CarryLewis/ECG-stimulator main (consolidated EP lab tip b32d1dc) at /ecg-simulator/.
